WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_quantity,
    AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_formula
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_formula,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity IS NULL, avg_quantity DESC) as rank
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_formula,
  rank
FROM step2
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, rank
